About Company

India's trusted name in global manpower consultancy

Lobo Offshore Recruitment & Maritime Services is an ISO-certified global human resource consultancy based in Mumbai, recognized as India's leading manpower agency. We are proudly approved by the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India under Registration Number B-0801/MUM/PART/1000+/5/9202/2016.

Our commitment to excellence is not a fleeting ambition but a deeply ingrained practice. By partnering with us, you gain access to a wealth of expertise and a dedicated approach to building a robust human resource base for your organization.

With over two decades of experience in the industry, our recruitment agency has built a global network of top-tier talent, enabling us to meet specialized needs with precision.

ISO 9001:2015 Certified MEA Government Approved Mumbai Headquartered Global Network
